name: onedrive
description: OneDrive for Business integration via Microsoft Graph — browse folders, search and read files, create folders, upload text files, and create organization-scoped sharing links on a user's drive. Uses app-only (client-credentials) auth against https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{userId}/drive and works with Microsoft 365 work/school accounts (not consumer OneDrive personal). Requires the Files.Read.All application permission for read tools and Files.ReadWrite.All for write tools, both with admin consent.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: OneDrive for Business files via Microsoft Graph (app-only); test endpoint '/' resolves to /users/{userId}/drive

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Azure AD tenant ID (GUID) of your Microsoft 365 organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the app registration.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret for the app registration. Requires the Files.Read.All application permission with admin consent; Files.ReadWrite.All is needed for the write tools.

fields.label: User (UPN/email)
fields.helpText: The OneDrive owner to operate on (app-only requires an explicit user).

tools.name: onedrive.list_folder
tools.description: List the items (files and folders) in a OneDrive folder. Lists the drive root when no path is given.

path.description: Drive-relative folder path (e.g. Documents/Reports). Omit to list the root.

tools.name: onedrive.search_files
tools.description: Search the user's OneDrive for files and folders matching a text query (matches names and file content).

query.description: Search text (e.g. a file name or keywords)

tools.name: onedrive.get_item
tools.description: Get metadata for a single file or folder by item id or drive-relative path, including webUrl, size, and parent path.

itemId.description: The drive item id (preferred if known)

path.description: Drive-relative path (e.g. Documents/Reports/q3.docx); used when itemId is not given

tools.name: onedrive.read_file
tools.description: Download a file's content and return it as UTF-8 text (capped at 512 KB). Refuses binary files — use onedrive.get_item and the webUrl for those.

itemId.description: The drive item id of the file to read

tools.name: onedrive.create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in the drive root or under a parent folder. Fails instead of renaming if a sibling with the same name already exists.

name.description: Name of the folder to create

parentPath.description: Drive-relative path of the parent folder (e.g. Documents). Omit to create in the root.

tools.name: onedrive.upload_file
tools.description: Upload text content as a file at a drive-relative path, creating or replacing the file (max 1 MB of text).

path.description: Drive-relative destination path including file name (e.g. Documents/notes.txt)

content.description: Text content of the file (UTF-8, max 1 MB)

tools.name: onedrive.create_share_link
tools.description: Create a view-only sharing link for a file or folder. App-only auth creates organization-scoped links (usable by people signed in to the tenant), not anonymous links.

itemId.description: The drive item id to share
